title: AccessibilityNode
description: One node of the accessibility snapshot of ADR 18205 (docs/decisions/18205-accessibility-tree-snapshot.md), as the shared corpus records it: `element` is the element's id. Adding an optional field or a states key is additive; removing or renaming one, or changing a type, is a breaking change that needs a new decision record.

role.description: WAI-ARIA role token; "text" for text leaves, "iframe" for frame leaves.

name.description: Computed accessible name; "" when there is none.

description.description: Computed accessible description; "" when there is none.

value.description: Current value; present only for textbox, searchbox, combobox and range roles.

element.description: The id of the backing element; absent for text leaves.
